meta.name: D4DJ
meta.description: Rinku Aimoto, who has a habit of saying "Happy Around!", has returned to Japan from abroad and enrolls at Yoba Academy where DJing is popular. She is deeply moved by a DJ concert she sees there and decides to form a unit of her own with DJ Maho Akashi, VJ Muni Ohnaruto and keyboardist Rei Togetsu. While interacting with other DJ units like Peaky P-key and Photon Maiden, Rinku and her friends aim for the high stage!

videos.title: First Mix
videos.overview: Rinku Aimoto, transfer student to Yoba Academy, meets DJ-in-training Maho Akashi. Seeing that Rinku is interested in DJ activities, Maho takes her to see the performance of the most popular DJ unit in the school, Peaky P-key. Consumed by the excitement of the performance, Rinku asks Maho to form a DJ unit with her.

videos.title: Next Step
videos.overview: Having formed a DJ unit with Rinku, Maho decides to host their first school concert. However, they are unable to attract the other students' attention. Looking for a way to change the situation, Maho comes across a school remix contest and decides to apply. She works all night and creates a remix that Rinku also likes, who then joins the contest alongside Maho. And the winner of the remix contest is...?!

videos.title: Only Me
videos.overview: Muni Ohnaruto realises that Rinku is her childhood friend, but she is hesitant to talk to her. However, she comes across Rinku and Maho discussing flyer designs, and can't stop herself from meddling in. Rinku rejoices at the reunion and asks Muni, who is a talented illustrator, to be the VJ (Video Jockey) of the group.

videos.title: Make My Song
videos.overview: Having welcomed Muni to the unit as VJ and gaining popularity through their concerts, Rinku and her friends decide to apply for a song composition contest. Rinku, who has started to practice piano for song making, introduces Teacher Rei-chan to Maho & Muni.

videos.title: One and Only
videos.overview: To gain more attention, Muni says she wants to take part in singing as well. Rei begins to compose music themed after Muni, while Rinku suggests to Rei to have a pajama party at Muni’s house to deepen their friendship.

videos.title: Fall Camp
videos.overview: Happy Around! has been formed at last! It seems everything is going smoothly for their DJ activities... but suddenly the final exams stand in Rinku, Muni, and Rei's path. To get them out of this crisis, Maho cooks curry...?!

videos.title: Holy Gifts
videos.overview: Happy Around! is preparing to hold a Christmas Event, but they are unable to book a concert hall on Christmas Eve. Rinku is deeply shocked, but Kyoko Yamate from Peaky P-key appears and...

videos.title: Dear Friend
videos.overview: Rinku's guest performance at Peaky P-key's Christmas Concert was well received, and she is very excited about the results. Seeing her joy, Maho becomes anxious and consults Shinobu Inuyose about the thoughts bothering her.

videos.title: Encounter With Light
videos.overview: Happy Around! places 8th in the Yoba Academy DJ rankings! However, the famous Photon Maiden has tied with them for 8th place. The two units face off to decide who will perform on the Sunset Stage.

videos.title: Brand New World
videos.overview: Photon Maiden awes the audience with their overwhelming performance. Happy Around! faces off with a new song which, following Rinku's idea, introduces Rei as the main vocal.

videos.title: Voice of Evolution
videos.overview: Having seen a new color in Happy Around!'s performance, Saki starts to explore if they too have new colors of their own. Thus, Photon Maiden encounters a light that they have never experienced before.

videos.title: Childhood Friends
videos.overview: Happy Around! decides to challenge rap following Rinku's idea, However, Rinku and Muni becomes estranged due to misunderstanding. Seeing Maho and Rei worried, Airi steps in to give them advice.

videos.title: Groovy Mix
videos.overview: Sunset Stage, the stage of their dreams. Rinku and her fellow Happy Around! members challenge the undisputed champions!

videos.title: Jan. "Beginning Beginning"
videos.overview: Lyrical Lily plans a town revitalization event, enlisting friends and rivals for an ambitious concert series.

videos.title: Feb. "Camera, Live, Action!"
videos.overview: To boost event buzz, the DJ units create a promo video showcasing the town's charm and their unique talents.

videos.title: Mar. "Freedom Freedom?"
videos.overview: The short film for Operation Beckoning Cat helped spread awareness of the town revitalization event, but the exceptional response raises the bar significantly, troubling Muni. To repay everyone's gratitude, Lyrical Lily takes the lead for the next stage. While they work hard on a new song with the theme of March, all units get together to enjoy the Doll Festival.

videos.title: Apr. "Spring Storm"
videos.overview: Facing a canceled show, Aoi proposes opening ALTER-EGO to the public, sparking debate and a race against time.

videos.title: May. "Negative/Positive"
videos.overview: Saori struggles with an international collaboration, but finds her rhythm with help from friends and music.

videos.title: Jun. "Daydream"
videos.overview: Maho is absent from the usual after school gathering. As they prepare for the next live show, the day begins on a strange note. Seeing other units praised for trying other concepts, Maho wants Happy Around! to leave an impact, too. What will Happy Around! do? What will happen to Operation Beckoning Cat?

videos.title: Jul. "You're So Cute!"
videos.overview: Photon Maiden is steadily working on a new song for Operation Beckoning Cat. However, Saki tells the members that she feels they need a new and different color. Noa, in agreement, gathers the rest and proposes writing a new song immediately. With Towa's help, she presents the idea of a ""self-introduction song"" to showcase their true selves.

videos.title: Sep. "Love and Sky"
videos.overview: Photon Maiden and LyriLily join forces for a training camp, where unexpected challenges await.

videos.title: Nov. "Because It's Cold"
videos.overview: Planning a December concert, the group dreams of a hot spring retreat to escape the winter chill.

videos.title: Dec. "On the Holy Night"
videos.overview: To hype up Christmas, the units plan a collab concert, but can they meet the high expectations?

videos.title: A Bright Future
videos.overview: Rinku's gift sparks a new idea for the countdown concert, but a sudden venue change challenges their plans.
